name: Suzanne B. O’Brien, RN
reason: Health rule / not mainly spiritual teaching (new reason, 4 Nov 2026): her own site (doulagivers.com home and about) presents Doulagivers Institute as hospice-adjacent end-of-life caregiving education by a hospice and palliative-care nurse, framed around terminally ill patients, home hospice and the eldercare crisis, with The Good Death pitched to clinicians and families facing advanced illness. Almost every item is patient-care training, so it fails the strict health rule. Judgement call; the owner may overturn. (No Shift Network mention on her site either.)
